heading: your journal

welcome.title: welcome to solstone.
welcome.body: the solstone app takes in what you share with it, and all of it goes into your journal.
how_it_fits: the solstone app takes in what you share with it, and all of it goes into your journal.
your journal is always private, only yours.

fits.title: how it fits together
fits.journal: lives on your journal's computer and keeps everything that goes into it.
fits.app: runs on each device you choose and takes in what you share with it. all of it goes into your journal.
fits.thinking: helps your journal make sense of what it keeps. choose where it happens below, or later.

login.label: start your journal when you sign in
login.help: start automatically after you sign in to your journal's computer.

folder.title: journal folder
folder.help: where your journal is kept on your journal's computer.

mark.title: your journal mark
mark.help: a unique mark for your journal. a phone or other computer you pair shows it too, so you can check it.
mark.error: your journal mark could not be loaded. try again.
mark.permanence: continue makes this your journal's mark for good.

thinking.title: thinking

choices.label: local
choices.description: model requests stay on your journal's computer.

choices.label: confidential processing
choices.description: sol pbc runs the model on confidential GPUs.

choices.label: your own model
choices.sub: your key, or your own endpoint
choices.description: your journal sends model requests to the provider or endpoint you choose. provider keys stay in your journal.

thinking.choose_later: choose thinking when you're ready. your journal keeps everything until then.

footer: your journal is kept on your journal's computer. thinking uses the option you choose.
